fields.product_description: Balenciaga Flared Pant in a sleek black finish with a dramatic flared silhouette. Designed to add movement and polish to elevated day or evening looks. Style it with a fitted top, structured jacket, or heels for a sharp statement.
Soft and smooth slipars for womens

Washed Silk Georgette Top by Balenciaga with a fluid drape and refined black tone. The lightweight silhouette makes it easy to dress up with tailored separates or wear casually with denim and trousers. A polished piece for modern day-to-night styling.

Balenciaga Cropped Trouser cut in a clean black finish for a sharp, modern fit. The cropped length adds a contemporary edge while staying easy to pair with shirts, knits, or statement outerwear. Ideal for sleek workwear and elevated casual looks.

Lapointe Coated Jersey Ruched Maxi Skirt with a sculpted silhouette and statement texture. The ruched detailing adds dimension while the longline shape creates an elegant finish. Pair it with fitted tops, boots, or heels for a standout evening look.

Lapointe Coated Jersey Ruched Bodysuit designed for a close, flattering fit with modern edge. The ruched construction adds texture and shape, making it an effortless base for skirts, tailoring, or statement trousers. A sleek piece for confident day-to-night styling.

Jersey Asymmetric Draped Sarong Dress by Lapointe Coated with fluid draping and an eye-catching asymmetric line. The silhouette is designed to flatter while bringing soft movement to the look. Style it for events, dinners, or elevated occasion dressing.

Jean Paul Gaultier Embroidered Long Sleeve Top finished in black with elevated detail. The long sleeve silhouette makes it easy to layer or wear as a standalone statement piece. Pair it with tailored pants, denim, or skirts for a refined modern look.

Savette Florence hobo bag crafted for everyday sophistication with a clean, structured silhouette. Spacious enough for essentials while still feeling polished and easy to carry. A versatile accessory that works effortlessly from day plans to evening outings.

Savette Symmetry Pochette Bag with a compact silhouette and refined modern finish. Designed to carry your essentials while adding a sleek accent to both occasion and everyday styling. An easy choice for minimal, polished looks.

Valentino Garavani Bowow Sandal designed to bring playful detail and effortless elegance to warm-weather styling. The streamlined sandal profile pairs easily with dresses, denim, and tailored separates. A standout finishing touch for day events, vacations, or evening plans.
